content.title: ‘NCIS’ Hits Massive 500-Episode Milestone With a Can't-Miss Release at 8 PM Tonight
content.text: Image via CBS Published Mar 24, 2026, 3:31 PM EDT Ryan O'Rourke is a Senior News Writer at Collider with a specific interest in all things adult animation, video game adaptations, and the work of Mike Flanagan. He is also an experienced baseball writer with over six years of articles between multiple outlets, most notably FanSided's CubbiesCrib. Whether it's taking in a baseball game, a new season of Futurama or Castlevania: Nocturne, or playing the latest From Software title, he is always finding ways to show his fandom. When it comes to gaming and anything that takes inspiration from it, he is deeply opinionated on what's going on. Outside of entertainment, he's a graduate of Eureka College with a Bachelor's in Communication where he honed his craft as a writer. Between The IV Leader at Illinois Valley Community College and The Pegasus at Eureka, he spent the majority of his college career publishing articles on everything from politics to campus happenings and, of course, entertainment for the student body. Those principles he learned covering the 2020 election, Palestine, and so much more are brought here to Collider, where he has gleefully written on everything from the SAG-AFTRA and WGA strikes to Nathan Lane baby-birding sewer boys. Sign in to your Collider account There's cause for celebration for CBS and the agents at the Washington Navy Yard. After nearly 23 years on-air, NCIS is about to reach a milestone few television series can even dream of — 500 episodes. Beginning as a spin-off of JAG in 2003, Donald P. Bellisario and Don McGill's flagship series has grown far beyond its origins, spurring six spin-offs of its own, cycling through many fan-favorite cast members like Mark Harmon, Michael Weatherly, and Cote de Pablo, and remaining a beloved mainstay of the network across multiple decades at this point. Longtime fans will want to tune in tonight, March 24, at 8 p.m. ET/PT, to catch the landmark moment live and experience a 500th episode filled with a few franchise Easter eggs for avid viewers. "When NCIS was happening, the character of McGee was a one-shot guest star that was written by Frank Cardea and George Schenck. [...] A couple of episodes later, they were three minutes short on an edit, so they had to come up with some material to make up a C story, and someone said, 'Let's bring back McGee, and we'll put him with Tony. They were fun together.' From that point on, McGee was just slowly a part of the thing." Related Reunions Not a Moment Too Soonions — The Collider TV Quiz! It's always fun when actors from one show find their way back to one another in a new show. Were these television reunions memorable to you? Collider Is Celebrating 500 Episodes of 'NCIS' With a Massive Retrospective Binder also looked back on one of the defining romances of the series between Anthony DiNozzo (Weatherly) and Ziva David (Pablo). Tiva's chemistry was palpable since the two first began working together in Season 3, and they became a pair that fans wanted to see together as the series built up their dynamic across multiple seasons. He spoke about how naturally the love story started, with the writing combined with Weatherly and Pablo's performances playing up their bond beyond just teammates in the eyes of fans. "As it turns out, that was the recipe for the audiences really wanting these two to get together. And I think when it's organic like that, that's where you get the most interesting relationships." It's stories like that, where good writing and skilled actors synergize perfectly, that have helped the NCIS team feel more like a family and keep viewers tuning in year after year.
